scoring_justification: Checker independently recomputes all analytic whisker-theory predictions from the same public parameters; compares agent-reported values within generous tolerances (factor-of-10 for W, h0, t0, tL; factor-of-100 for growth rate; absolute ±0.5 for distribution peak).

outputs.description: Computed predictions from the electrostatic whisker nucleation and growth theory.

output_contract.notes: All values are computed from the stated input parameters; the checker independently recomputes the same formulas and compares each value within generous factor-based tolerances.
